snippet.title: Dawnhold - Official Gameplay Trailer | Action Base-Defense
snippet.description:
Dawnhold is available now on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4642990/Dawnhold/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=video&utm_campaign=gameplay_trailer

Gather resources, build walls and towers, fight enemy waves, assault Hollowborn strongholds, and defeat powerful bosses in this top-down action base-defense game.

Each mission starts fresh, challenging you to balance gathering, building, combat, and attacks on enemy strongholds before the pressure becomes too much.

Game Assets by: @elvgamestudio 

#Dawnhold #indiegame #pixelart
